title: Synthetic ordinary temperature and vibration band
provenance_detail: Original synthetic normal-condition note authored for ShopfloorPilot; its ordinary band is fixture-relative and not an industrial specification.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: Temperature and vibration readings described as remaining in the ordinary synthetic operating band support continued observation rather than a fault hypothesis. Preserve the trend because an ordinary reading does not prove that every machine condition is healthy.
observable_symptoms: temperature remains in the ordinary synthetic operating band
vibration remains in the ordinary synthetic operating band
suggested_checks: Retain the observation as a synthetic trend reference.
Continue normal observation at the next planned checkpoint.
Investigate only if another public alarm, status change, or conflicting reading appears.
limitations: The ordinary band is uncalibrated and scenario-specific.
This note neither certifies health nor rules out unobserved conditions.
